standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-characteristic-vs-minimal-polynomial (source lemma, worklist row 36): for a finite extension L over K and alpha in L with minimal polynomial P of degree d, the characteristic polynomial of the K-linear multiplication map m_alpha on L equals P^e, where e d = [L : K]

Chapter definitions: Trace of an element is minus the coefficient of x with exponent n-1, and Norm is (-1)^n times the constant term, of the characteristic polynomial of the multiplication map, n = [L : K]
core_obligations: The characteristic polynomial of m_alpha is P^e = (x^d + a_1 x^(d-1) + ... + a_d)^e by the cited lemma

Extract the two coefficients: the x^(ed-1) term of P^e is e a_1 (choose the x^(d-1) term from one factor and constants elsewhere), so Trace = - e a_1; the constant term is a_d^e, so Norm = (-1)^(ed) a_d^e = (-1)^[L:K] a_d^e
proof_roadmap: Identify the characteristic polynomial with a power of the minimal polynomial
Extract the trace and norm coefficients from the power
